# Lumen & Co — Technology Credentials

Lumen & Co is a digital agency with offices in Lisbon (Portugal) and Austin (USA). Its positioning line is "We build what's next". This document lists Lumen & Co's curated technology case studies and its curated work.

## Case study: Nimbus Retail

Lumen & Co grew Nimbus Retail's online storefront through a full platform rebuild.

Lumen & Co unified Nimbus Retail's checkout and inventory systems into a single, scalable platform built on React and PostgreSQL.

Services Lumen & Co delivered to Nimbus Retail: UI/UX, Storefront Rebuild.

Technology Lumen & Co used for Nimbus Retail: React, PostgreSQL.

Site: shop.nimbusretail.example

## Case study: Hartwell Logistics

Lumen & Co grew Hartwell Logistics' dispatch efficiency by building a real-time fleet dashboard.

Lumen & Co designed and built a fleet tracking dashboard for Hartwell Logistics that surfaces live vehicle positions, delivery ETAs and driver workload.

Services Lumen & Co delivered to Hartwell Logistics: Fleet Dashboard, Analytics & Reporting.

Technology Lumen & Co used for Hartwell Logistics: Kubernetes.

Highlights of the Hartwell Logistics project: live GPS tracking, automated ETA recalculation, and a driver workload heatmap.

## Case study: Orbit Analytics Inc

Lumen & Co grew Orbit Analytics Inc's reporting speed with a redesigned dashboard suite.

Lumen & Co rebuilt Orbit Analytics Inc's internal reporting tools into a single dashboard suite, cutting report generation time from hours to minutes.

Services Lumen & Co delivered to Orbit Analytics Inc: Enterprise Dashboard Design, Workflow Automation.

## Case study: Orbit Analytics

A later engagement: Orbit Analytics also received a Storefront Rebuild from Lumen & Co, extending the dashboard suite work into a public-facing storefront.

Services Lumen & Co delivered to Orbit Analytics: Storefront Rebuild.
